notes.title: Big update 0.3
notes.content:
Hello! After a long period of time, we are ready to present you an update that will transfer the game to version 0.3

The first thing we want to notify you about is the price reduction
We thought that at the moment the game is not worth the money, and the price is not affordable for many, so it was decided to lower the price, we hope we have made the game available to everyone


New Mode: Campaign
This mode currently includes 1 sub-mode, in the future the number of sub-modes will be replenished. Each sub-mode has its own gameplay and its own rules.

At the moment, one of the sub-modes is available - From point A to point B.
In this mode, you have a limited number of resources in your inventory, from which you must build a vehicle to deliver a SPECIAL ITEM to the finish line. With each level, there will be more and more obstacles, and the items will change.

Also, you can offer your ideas for new campaign modes, or give advice on improving the mode (From point A to point B). You can do this in the game community on Steam or by joining our Discord server , there are a lot of interesting things there, we will be glad to see everyone!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40847602/40279c80a8f5bc9f9723c75f8df51a6bb9748099.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40847602/60b04fbb1e35b4ee0c9751d2eedccfc0cb6fd2c5.png
You can learn more by reading the instructions in the game

New main menu interface
